events.text:
T-273 is back in review for Adi and Bharath. The Workshop Hub now calls the free platform pass a Two-Month Platform Pass everywhere, the change is live, and the link probe passes.

- **b-pass in `review_hub.py`:** done. It now reads "Two-Month Platform Pass" with "Two months of the platform the engine runs on.", copied word for word from `funnel.ts`. The Orchestrator's note said "on the platform"; I went with `funnel.ts` because the note also said to copy that file exactly. I left out any "worth $" amount.
- **"1 month" in the offer ladder:** done. That ladder text is written directly in `index.html`, not produced by `review_hub.py`, so I edited it there. It now says "two months of the platform the engine runs on" with the label "Two months". No "1 month, worth" is left anywhere on the page.
- **`app/src/lib/vip-kit.ts`:** left alone, as the decision said.
- **Regenerate and probe:** done. `review_hub.py` rebuilt the page (475 elements). `node app/scripts/probe-review-hub.mjs` checked the live hub and reported ALL LINKS OK.
- **No October dates in `index.html`:** done. The only "Oct" left is the month list the page script uses to fill in cohort dates.
- **Commit and push to main:** done. Commit f341d58f is on origin/main.
- **Republish the mirror:** done. Mirror commit 4f6e8f861 is live. One early fetch still showed the old page from cache; three later cache-busted fetches all show the new wording.
- **AUDIT.md H025 row:** the row now cites f341d58f. That folder is not a git repo, so the edit is saved but nothing could be committed.
- **Task log and ack:** T-273 is in review with evidence links, and note F-8aa58f92 is acknowledged.
